description: Read a Lua or XML file from Blizzard's shipped interface source, by the path that wow_ui_grep or wow_ui_template_search reported. Use this to see a full implementation in context rather than a single matching line.

path.description: Path relative to the UI source root, e.g. Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_UIParent/UIParent.lua.

name: wow_ui_read_file
title: Read a file from Blizzard's UI source
